package: @astryxdesign/core

# LayoutFooter

Bottom bar for action bars, pagination, status bars.

**Import:** `import {LayoutFooter} from '@astryxdesign/core/Layout';`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | - | Footer content. |
| `hasDivider` | `boolean` | `false` | Border at top edge; unset uses the Layout default. |
| `height` | `SizeValue` | - | Footer height. |
| `label` | `string` | - | Accessible label for landmark element. |
| `padding` | `0 \| 0.5 \| 1 \| 1.5 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 8 \| 10` | - | Padding on every edge; replaces the layout inset. 0 is full bleed. |
| `role` | `AriaRole` | - | ARIA landmark role. |
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | - | Ref forwarded to the footer element. |
